items.title: Wings of Change 10 Years of Redefining Regional Air Connectivity through UDAN
items.summary: 20 OCT 2026 10:17AM by PIB Delhi UDAN completes ten years in 2026. Over the past decade, it has expanded India’s regional aviation network, connecting unserved & underserved regions and improving access to air travel. Regional connectivity has supported tourism, medical access, agricultural trade and local employment, with airports such as Tezu, Deoghar and Kishangarh illustrating its impact.

facts.text: In line with this objective, the Regional Connectivity Scheme (RCS), also known as UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik), was launched on 21 October 2016.
India is now the world’s third-largest domestic aviation market , with operational airports increasing from 74 in 2014 to 166 till date .
UDAN entered its operational stage with the inauguration of the first RCS-UDAN flight from Shimla to Delhi in April 2017 .
Flights Operated: More than 3.68 lakh flights have been operated under the scheme.
